mapper.select: SELECT jj.JM_CD AS jmCd , jj.KOSCOM_CD AS koscom_cd , jj.JJ_FNM AS jjFnm , jj.JJ_NM AS jjNm , jj.JJ_ENM AS jjEnm , jj.BALH_CO AS balhCo , jj.WOOS_ILBAN_GB AS woosIlbanGb , jj.CHG_GB AS chgGb , jj.NEW_OLD_GB AS newOldGb , jj.DANC_GB AS dancGb , jj.BALH_GA AS balhGa , TO_CHAR(jj.SANGJ_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sangjYmd , jj.SANGJ_JUSU AS sangjJusu , jj.KOSPIGUBUN AS kospigubun , jb.BALH_NATION AS xxBalhNation , jj.USPM AS uspm FROM SJM0JJ jj LEFT OUTER JOIN SJX0JB jb ON jb.BALH_CO = jj.BALH_CO WHERE jj.DANC_GB IN ('A', 'C') AND NVL(jj.DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN jj.USPM = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, jj.KOSCOM_CD ASC

SELECT t1.KOSCOM_CD AS koscomCd , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.CLOSE AS close , t1.VOLUME AS volume , t1.VALUE / 100000000 AS value , t1.PRECLOSE AS preclose , t1.CHANGE AS change FROM SJT1TG t1 WHERE t1.YMD >= ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), -12) AND t1.KOSCOM_CD = #{koscomCd} ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO USPM_DD t USING DUAL ON (t.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t.YMD = TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t.JM_CD = #{jmCd} AND t.OVRS_EXCG_CD = #{ovrsExcgCd}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CORP_GR, YMD, JM_CD, OVRS_EXCG_CD) VALUES (#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{jmCd}, #{ovrsExcgCd})
